# Cristina Andrés — Portfolio (full content)

Source of truth for AI-assisted answers about Cristina Andrés and her design portfolio.
Last reviewed: 2026.

## Identity

Cristina Andrés is a Spain-based product, UX/UI and graphic designer. She is a passionate
product and graphic designer with a solid foundation in industrial design engineering. She
understands the intricate balance between form and function, and her expertise extends
beyond conceptualization: she brings ideas to life through meticulous attention to detail
and a keen eye for user experience.

- Full name: Cristina Andrés
- Job title: Product, UX/UI & Graphic Designer
- Primary website: https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app
- Email: cristina.andresrr@gmail.com
- Booking: https://calendly.com/cristina-andresrr/30min
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/cristinaandrs/
- Behance: https://www.behance.net/cristinaandrs

## Education

- Industrial Design Engineering and Product Development — Polytechnical University of
  Valencia, Spain (primary degree).
- Erasmus exchange — He-ARC, Neuchâtel, Switzerland.
- Erasmus exchange — Hochschule Augsburg (University of Applied Sciences), Germany.

## Professional experience

- UX/UI Designer — Freelance (2023 — present). Independent client work spanning digital
  product design, branding and packaging.
- Graphic Designer — Future Fibres Rigging Systems S.L. (2022). In-house graphic design
  for a marine rigging company.

## Languages

Native or fluent in Spanish, Catalan, French and English.

## Skills and expertise

- UX Design
- UI Design
- Product Design
- Graphic Design
- Branding
- Packaging Design
- Industrial Design Engineering

## Selected projects

### Aqualung — UX/UI Designer (2025)
Worked as the UX/UI Designer at a diving equipment company. Designed digital interfaces
for Aqualung Group's product line.

### Curefab — Website Design (2024)
Website redesign for Curefab Technologies GmbH, a German company.

### Punt — Product Design (2023)
Product design for a wooden sideboard for Punt.

### Montezuma — Marketing (2022)
New marketing strategy and packaging design for Montezuma.

### Smurfit Kappa — Packaging Design (2022)
Packaging design for bulk products at Smurfit Kappa.

### Ares Domus — Branding (2022)
Brand design concept for a luxury resort.

### Sakana — Product Design (2022)
Design of a Swiss watch.

### Ciclogreen — Product Design (2021)
Indoor growing system.

### Blossom — Product Design (2020)
Flower-shaped lamp with articulated petals. Includes a published product manual
(Blossom_Manual_A4.pdf).

## Personal activities

In addition to client work, Cristina maintains two creative side projects featured under
the Activities section of her portfolio:

- 3D Modeling in Blender — Personal experiments with form, lighting and material studies.
  See: https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/activities/blender
- Animal Crossing — Personal showcase of island design, environments and visual
  storytelling.
  See: https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/activities/animal-crossing
